newsitem.title: USA: Emerging market debt mixed in subdued U.S. trading.
newsitem.headline: Emerging market debt mixed in subdued U.S. trading.

text.p: Emerging market debt prices were mixed on Monday as traders made minor adjustments to their positions after last week's losses in sympathy with falling U.S. Treasuries, traders and analysts said.
"The sentiment is okay, but people don't want to take risks," said Richard Segal, head of emerging market fixed income research at Santander Investments.
Last week's mini-selloff on Thursday and Friday unnerved some players who still felt vulnerable from the setback on August 1 when the market was rocked by the July payrolls data, he said.
